name: IBY_ACCT_PMT_PROFILES_B
description: IBY_ACCT_PMT_PROFILES stores account-related information that completes the specification of the handling of payment instructions. Entries in this table are based on entries in the IBY_SYS_PMT_PROFILES table. A combination of the two tables is defined in the view IBY_PAYMENT_PROFILES. The selection of a payment process profile is driven by the payment method assigned to a document and other factors. This table corresponds to the Payment Process Profiles pages.

columns.name: PAYMENT_PROFILE_ID
columns.description: System-generated primary key.

columns.name: SYSTEM_PROFILE_CODE
columns.description: System payment process profile Identifier

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: BEP_ACCOUNT_ID
columns.description: Payment system account Identifier

columns.name: SECURITY_CONFIGURATION_ID
columns.description: Security configuration Identifier

columns.name: TRANSMIT_CONFIGURATION_ID
columns.description: Transmission configuration Identifier

columns.name: RESET_VALUE_1
columns.description: Value to which the first sequence is reset

columns.name: LAST_USED_NUMBER_1
columns.description: Last number that was used by the first sequence

columns.name: RESET_REQUEST_1
columns.description: Identifier of the concurrent request used to reset the first sequence

columns.name: RESET_VALUE_2
columns.description: Value to which the second sequence is reset

columns.name: LAST_USED_NUMBER_2
columns.description: Last number that was used by the second sequence

columns.name: RESET_REQUEST_2
columns.description: Identifier of the concurrent request used to reset the second sequence

columns.name: RESET_VALUE_3
columns.description: Value to which the third sequence is reset

columns.name: LAST_USED_NUMBER_3
columns.description: Last number that was used by the third sequence

columns.name: RESET_REQUEST_3
columns.description: Identifier of the concurrent request used to reset the third sequence

columns.name: INACTIVE_DATE
columns.description: Inactive date

columns.name: ACK_SEC_CONFIG_ID
columns.description: Security configuration identifier for acknowledgment file

columns.name: ACK_TRANSMIT_CONFIG_ID
columns.description: Transmission configuration Identifier for acknowledgment file

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: Date from which the payment system account is available for use in the context of a payment process profile.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: Date until which the payment system account is available for use in the context of a payment process profile.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.
